title: "07_interpret_grade_associated_MOFA2_factors"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-11"

Purpose:
1. Interpret Factor5 and Factor6 by direction.
2. Map factor direction to Grade II / Grade III.
3. Separate RNA, CNV, WES mutation, and IMPACT mutation features.
4. Filter RNA features to protein-coding genes using GENCODE if available.
5. Export enrichment-ready gene lists.
6. Run GO/Reactome enrichment

# Aim

This analysis interprets the grade-associated MOFA2 factors identified in the union multi-omics model.

The prior validation showed:

- Factor5 is higher in Grade III tumors.
- Factor6 is higher in Grade II tumors.

This script maps MOFA2 feature weights to biological directions and exports interpretable gene lists by factor, direction, and omics view.

# Parameters

```{r parameters}
GRADE_FACTORS <- c("Factor5", "Factor6")

TOP_N_FOR_TABLES <- 50
TOP_N_FOR_ENRICHMENT <- 200

# For enrichment, use top weighted RNA genes by absolute direction.
# Protein-coding filtering will be applied if GENCODE annotation is found.
```

# Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
clean_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  # Remove possible gene IDs after separators if present
  x <- sub("\\|.*$", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\..*$", "", x)

  x
}

extract_gtf_attribute <- function(attr, key) {
  pattern <- paste0(key, " \"([^\"]+)\"")
  out <- sub(paste0(".*", pattern, ".*"), "\\1", attr)
  out[!grepl(pattern, attr)] <- NA_character_
  out
}

read_gencode_gene_annotation <- function(gtf_file) {
  if (!file.exists(gtf_file)) {
    warning("GENCODE GTF not found: ", gtf_file)
    return(NULL)
  }

  message("Reading GENCODE annotation: ", gtf_file)

  gtf <- fread(
    gtf_file,
    sep = "\t",
    header = FALSE,
    quote = "",
    data.table = TRUE,
    showProgress = TRUE
  )

  colnames(gtf) <- c(
    "seqname",
    "source",
    "feature",
    "start",
    "end",
    "score",
    "strand",
    "frame",
    "attribute"
  )

  genes <- gtf[feature == "gene"]

  genes[, gene_id := extract_gtf_attribute(attribute, "gene_id")]
  genes[, gene_name := extract_gtf_attribute(attribute, "gene_name")]
  genes[, gene_type := extract_gtf_attribute(attribute, "gene_type")]

  genes <- unique(genes[, .(gene_id, gene_name, gene_type)])

  genes[, gene_name := clean_gene_symbol(gene_name)]

  genes
}

assign_grade_direction <- function(factor, weight_value, direction_table) {
  # direction_table has Factor and Association_direction
  assoc <- direction_table[Factor == factor, Association_direction]

  if (length(assoc) == 0 || is.na(assoc)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  if (assoc == "Higher in Grade III") {
    ifelse(weight_value > 0, "GradeIII_associated", "GradeII_associated")
  } else if (assoc == "Higher in Grade II") {
    ifelse(weight_value > 0, "GradeII_associated", "GradeIII_associated")
  } else {
    NA_character_
  }
}

safe_write_gene_list <- function(genes, outfile) {
  genes <- unique(genes)
  genes <- genes[!is.na(genes) & genes != ""]
  writeLines(genes, outfile)
  message("[SAVED] ", outfile, " | N genes = ", length(genes))
}

plot_top_weights <- function(dt, factor_name, view_name, grade_direction, outfile, top_n = 20) {
  tmp <- dt[
    factor == factor_name &
      view == view_name &
      Grade_direction == grade_direction
  ][
    order(-abs(value))
  ][
    1:min(.N, top_n)
  ]

  if (nrow(tmp) == 0) return(NULL)

  tmp[, feature := factor(feature, levels = rev(feature))]

  p <- ggplot(
    tmp,
    aes(
      x = feature,
      y = value
    )
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(factor_name, " - ", view_name),
      subtitle = paste0(grade_direction, " features"),
      x = "Feature",
      y = "MOFA2 weight"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    outfile,
    p,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )

  p
}
```

# Load grade validation and MOFA2 weights

```{r load-data}
all_weights <- fread(ALL_WEIGHT_FILE, data.table = TRUE)
grade_validation <- fread(GRADE_VALIDATION_FILE, data.table = TRUE)
grade_interpretation <- fread(GRADE_INTERPRETATION_FILE, data.table = TRUE)

cat("All MOFA2 weights dimensions:\n")
print(dim(all_weights))

cat("Grade validation table:\n")
print(grade_validation)

cat("Grade interpretation table:\n")
print(grade_interpretation)

print(head(all_weights))
```

# Prepare direction table

```{r direction-table}
direction_table <- grade_interpretation[
  Factor %in% GRADE_FACTORS,
  .(
    Factor,
    Association_direction,
    Median_Grade_II,
    Median_Grade_III,
    Difference_GradeIII_minus_GradeII,
    Wilcoxon_P,
    FDR
  )
]

fwrite(
  direction_table,
  file.path(INTERP_DIR, "Grade_associated_factor_direction_table.csv")
)

print(direction_table)
```

# Annotate weights with grade-associated direction

```{r annotate-weights}
weights_grade <- all_weights[factor %in% GRADE_FACTORS]

weights_grade[, feature_clean := clean_gene_symbol(feature)]

weights_grade[, Weight_direction := fifelse(
  value > 0,
  "Positive_weight",
  fifelse(value < 0, "Negative_weight", "Zero_weight")
)]

weights_grade[, Grade_direction := mapply(
  assign_grade_direction,
  factor,
  value,
  MoreArgs = list(direction_table = direction_table)
)]

weights_grade[, Abs_weight := abs(value)]

fwrite(
  weights_grade,
  file.path(INTERP_DIR, "MOFA2_all_weights_grade_factors_with_grade_direction.csv")
)

cat("Grade factor weights with direction:\n")
print(head(weights_grade))
```

# Add GENCODE annotation and protein-coding flag

```{r gencode-annotation}
gencode_genes <- read_gencode_gene_annotation(GENCODE_GTF)

if (!is.null(gencode_genes)) {
  weights_grade <- merge(
    weights_grade,
    gencode_genes,
    by.x = "feature_clean",
    by.y = "gene_name",
    all.x = TRUE
  )

  weights_grade[, Is_protein_coding := gene_type == "protein_coding"]

} else {
  weights_grade[, gene_id := NA_character_]
  weights_grade[, gene_type := NA_character_]
  weights_grade[, Is_protein_coding := NA]
}

fwrite(
  weights_grade,
  file.path(INTERP_DIR, "MOFA2_grade_factor_weights_with_GENCODE_annotation.csv")
)

cat("Gene type summary for RNA view:\n")
print(
  weights_grade[
    grepl("^RNA", view),
    .N,
    by = .(gene_type, Is_protein_coding)
  ][order(-N)]
)
```

# Create gene lists by factor, view, and grade direction

```{r create-gene-lists}
gene_list_summary <- list()
k <- 1

for (fac in GRADE_FACTORS) {
  for (gd in c("GradeII_associated", "GradeIII_associated")) {
    for (vv in unique(weights_grade$view)) {

      tmp <- weights_grade[
        factor == fac &
          Grade_direction == gd &
          view == vv
      ][order(-Abs_weight)]

      if (nrow(tmp) == 0) next

      genes_all <- unique(tmp$feature_clean)
      genes_all <- genes_all[!is.na(genes_all) & genes_all != ""]

      outfile_all <- file.path(
        GENE_DIR,
        paste0(fac, "_", gd, "_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", vv), "_all_features.txt")
      )

      safe_write_gene_list(genes_all, outfile_all)

      gene_list_summary[[k]] <- data.table(
        Factor = fac,
        Grade_direction = gd,
        View = vv,
        Gene_list_type = "All_features",
        N = length(genes_all),
        File = outfile_all
      )
      k <- k + 1

      # Protein-coding RNA-only list
      if (grepl("^RNA", vv)) {
        tmp_pc <- tmp[Is_protein_coding == TRUE]

        genes_pc <- unique(tmp_pc$feature_clean)
        genes_pc <- genes_pc[!is.na(genes_pc) & genes_pc != ""]

        outfile_pc <- file.path(
          GENE_DIR,
          paste0(fac, "_", gd, "_RNA_protein_coding_features.txt")
        )

        safe_write_gene_list(genes_pc, outfile_pc)

        gene_list_summary[[k]] <- data.table(
          Factor = fac,
          Grade_direction = gd,
          View = vv,
          Gene_list_type = "RNA_protein_coding",
          N = length(genes_pc),
          File = outfile_pc
        )
        k <- k + 1

        # Top N protein-coding RNA genes for enrichment
        genes_pc_top <- unique(tmp_pc[1:min(.N, TOP_N_FOR_ENRICHMENT), feature_clean])
        genes_pc_top <- genes_pc_top[!is.na(genes_pc_top) & genes_pc_top != ""]

        outfile_pc_top <- file.path(
          GENE_DIR,
          paste0(fac, "_", gd, "_RNA_top", TOP_N_FOR_ENRICHMENT, "_protein_coding_for_enrichment.txt")
        )

        safe_write_gene_list(genes_pc_top, outfile_pc_top)

        gene_list_summary[[k]] <- data.table(
          Factor = fac,
          Grade_direction = gd,
          View = vv,
          Gene_list_type = paste0("RNA_top", TOP_N_FOR_ENRICHMENT, "_protein_coding_for_enrichment"),
          N = length(genes_pc_top),
          File = outfile_pc_top
        )
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
}

gene_list_summary <- rbindlist(gene_list_summary, fill = TRUE)

fwrite(
  gene_list_summary,
  file.path(INTERP_DIR, "MOFA2_grade_factor_gene_list_summary.csv")
)

print(gene_list_summary)
```

# GO Biological Process using clusterProfiler

```{r go-enrichment}
run_go_enrichment <- function(gene_vector, label) {
  if (!requireNamespace("clusterProfiler", quietly = TRUE) ||
      !requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("clusterProfiler/org.Hs.eg.db not installed. Skipping GO enrichment for ", label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(clusterProfiler)
    library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  })

  gene_vector <- unique(gene_vector)
  gene_vector <- gene_vector[!is.na(gene_vector) & gene_vector != ""]

  if (length(gene_vector) < 10) {
    message("Too few genes for GO enrichment: ", label, " | N=", length(gene_vector))
    return(NULL)
  }

  ego <- tryCatch({
    enrichGO(
      gene          = gene_vector,
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType       = "SYMBOL",
      ont           = "BP",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.1,
      qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,
      readable      = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("GO enrichment failed for ", label, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(ego)) return(NULL)

  ego_dt <- as.data.table(ego@result)

  outfile <- file.path(
    ENRICH_DIR,
    paste0(label, "_GO_BP_enrichment.csv")
  )

  fwrite(ego_dt, outfile)
  message("[SAVED] ", outfile)

  if (nrow(ego_dt) > 0) {
    pdf(
      file.path(ENRICH_DIR, paste0(label, "_GO_BP_dotplot.pdf")),
      width = 8,
      height = 6
    )
    print(dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15))
    dev.off()
  }

  ego_dt
}

go_results <- list()

for (fac in GRADE_FACTORS) {
  for (gd in c("GradeII_associated", "GradeIII_associated")) {

    tmp <- weights_grade[
      factor == fac &
        Grade_direction == gd &
        grepl("^RNA", view) &
        Is_protein_coding == TRUE
    ][order(-Abs_weight)]

    genes <- unique(tmp[1:min(.N, TOP_N_FOR_ENRICHMENT), feature_clean])

    label <- paste0(fac, "_", gd, "_RNA_top", TOP_N_FOR_ENRICHMENT, "_protein_coding")

    go_results[[label]] <- run_go_enrichment(genes, label)
  }
}
```

# Reactome using ReactomePA

```{r reactome-enrichment}
run_reactome_enrichment <- function(gene_vector, label) {
  if (!requireNamespace("ReactomePA", quietly = TRUE) ||
      !requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE) ||
      !requireNamespace("clusterProfiler", quietly = TRUE)) {
    message("ReactomePA/org.Hs.eg.db/clusterProfiler not installed. Skipping Reactome enrichment for ", label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(ReactomePA)
    library(org.Hs.eg.db)
    library(clusterProfiler)
  })

  gene_vector <- unique(gene_vector)
  gene_vector <- gene_vector[!is.na(gene_vector) & gene_vector != ""]

  if (length(gene_vector) < 10) {
    message("Too few genes for Reactome enrichment: ", label, " | N=", length(gene_vector))
    return(NULL)
  }

  entrez <- tryCatch({
    bitr(
      gene_vector,
      fromType = "SYMBOL",
      toType = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Gene ID conversion failed for ", label, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(entrez) || nrow(entrez) < 10) {
    message("Too few ENTREZ IDs for Reactome enrichment: ", label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  er <- tryCatch({
    enrichPathway(
      gene = unique(entrez$ENTREZID),
      organism = "human",
      pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      readable = TRUE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Reactome enrichment failed for ", label, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(er)) return(NULL)

  er_dt <- as.data.table(er@result)

  outfile <- file.path(
    ENRICH_DIR,
    paste0(label, "_Reactome_enrichment.csv")
  )

  fwrite(er_dt, outfile)
  message("[SAVED] ", outfile)

  if (nrow(er_dt) > 0) {
    pdf(
      file.path(ENRICH_DIR, paste0(label, "_Reactome_dotplot.pdf")),
      width = 8,
      height = 6
    )
    print(dotplot(er, showCategory = 15))
    dev.off()
  }

  er_dt
}

reactome_results <- list()

for (fac in GRADE_FACTORS) {
  for (gd in c("GradeII_associated", "GradeIII_associated")) {

    tmp <- weights_grade[
      factor == fac &
        Grade_direction == gd &
        grepl("^RNA", view) &
        Is_protein_coding == TRUE
    ][order(-Abs_weight)]

    genes <- unique(tmp[1:min(.N, TOP_N_FOR_ENRICHMENT), feature_clean])

    label <- paste0(fac, "_", gd, "_RNA_top", TOP_N_FOR_ENRICHMENT, "_protein_coding")

    reactome_results[[label]] <- run_reactome_enrichment(genes, label)
  }
}
```

# Final interpretation table

```{r final-interpretation-table}
final_interpretation <- rbindlist(lapply(GRADE_FACTORS, function(fac) {

  fac_dir <- direction_table[Factor == fac, Association_direction]

  if (length(fac_dir) == 0) fac_dir <- NA_character_

  fac_summary <- compact_summary[factor == fac]

  grade2_features <- fac_summary[
    Grade_direction == "GradeII_associated",
    .(
      GradeII_feature_summary = paste(
        paste(view, Top_features, sep = ": "),
        collapse = " | "
      )
    )
  ]

  grade3_features <- fac_summary[
    Grade_direction == "GradeIII_associated",
    .(
      GradeIII_feature_summary = paste(
        paste(view, Top_features, sep = ": "),
        collapse = " | "
      )
    )
  ]

  data.table(
    Factor = fac,
    Factor_score_direction = fac_dir,
    Median_Grade_II = direction_table[Factor == fac, Median_Grade_II],
    Median_Grade_III = direction_table[Factor == fac, Median_Grade_III],
    Wilcoxon_P = direction_table[Factor == fac, Wilcoxon_P],
    FDR = direction_table[Factor == fac, FDR],
    GradeII_associated_features = ifelse(nrow(grade2_features) > 0, grade2_features$GradeII_feature_summary, NA_character_),
    GradeIII_associated_features = ifelse(nrow(grade3_features) > 0, grade3_features$GradeIII_feature_summary, NA_character_)
  )
}), fill = TRUE)

fwrite(
  final_interpretation,
  file.path(INTERP_DIR, "MOFA2_grade_associated_factor_final_interpretation_summary.csv")
)

print(final_interpretation)
```
